title: SelCal M6-P1 artifact contract v7 proposal
description: Closed revision 7 proposal for conditional replay of ordered states from completed production actual.replicates, exhaustive serial-writer failure accounting, discriminator-coupled terminal axes, bounded source-set identities, interleaved diagnostics, lifecycle-separated budget profiles, and deterministic resource operands.
x-claimCeiling: Structural validity of this proposal does not approve the formula/profile, authorize implementation, establish execution, prove semantic cross-record invariants, complete M6, approve release, or establish SoftwareX readiness.

x-canonicalization.jsonObjectBytes: UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); JSON files have no BOM and no trailing LF
x-canonicalization.jsonlRowBytes: canonical JSON object bytes followed by exactly one LF byte; no blank rows; final row also has LF
x-canonicalization.fileSha256Domain: all raw bytes from byte zero through EOF
x-canonicalization.rowSha256Domain: one complete canonical JSONL row including its terminating LF
x-canonicalization.ledgerSha256Domain: raw chunk bytes concatenated in ascending chunkIndex without separators
x-canonicalization.projectionSha256Domain: canonical productionProjection object bytes without LF
x-canonicalization.floatSemanticRoundTrip: Every FloatHex value must decode to a finite IEEE-754 binary64 value and Python float.fromhex(value).hex() must equal value exactly, including signed zero; schema pattern matching alone is insufficient
x-canonicalization.noSelfHash: No run artifact, profile projection, schema, formula, terminal root, or external approval projection contains its own byte digest. Approved linkage is external and non-cyclic.

x-semanticVerifier.name: verify_m6_p1_artifact_contract_v7_semantics
requirements: require artifactStatus PROPOSAL_UNAPPROVED only with ContractBindingProposal and APPROVED_FROZEN only with ContractBindingApproved whose external projection and three digests match independently frozen bytes
require every FloatHex to decode to finite IEEE-754 binary64 and satisfy float.fromhex(value).hex() == value exactly including signed zero
reject bool for every integer and recompute every integer within its formula-specific domain before arithmetic

require primary terminalStatus NULL_DISABLED to execute zero statistic scans and create no observed or completed-replicate-state artifact, emit no primary rows, preserve null inferential fields, and produce exactly one NOT_COMPARABLE comparison record

require observed analytic failure to execute only the observed scan and expose no executed replicate outcomes, emit zero state rows, retain the logical empty primary digest, and satisfy unexecutedReplicateCount=B with all valid/E/F/numerator/denominator/bound/p/decision fields null
require exact T+1, ordinary finite B+2, observed-failure 2, and null-bind 1 comparison cardinalities and exact record ordering
require comparison discovery and required diagnostic groups to execute interleaved with maxPendingDiagnosticJobs=0 before the comparison row is finalized
require diagnosticRowIndex global continuity, diagnosticIndex <=255, bodyIndex group continuity, strict header/edge/code/counterKey/numerical/footer variants, and footer count/hash closure

require productionCountersStatus AVAILABLE to have null reason and complete both production directions; NOT_EXPOSED requires a fixed reason, zero expected production counter rows, and no PRODUCTION_SOURCE counter row

require exactly three source-set manifests, one per role, with contiguous ordinal values, ASCII-lexicographic paths, sourceCount and totalSourceBytes equality, sourceSetId digest closure, entry hashes, and closed transitive-dependency policy
require success-root status, overallComparisonStatus, diagnostic presence, and axisStates to select the same exact success triple
require failureClass and failedStage to select the exact cross-axis failure triple and the permitted partial success-root custody branch

require failure root and installed comparison-manifest.json to be mutually exclusive; preserved success-root evidence may only be comparison-manifest.json.partial and must also occur in retainedArtifacts with matching verification
recompute every descriptor byte count/hash, all chunk/index continuity, all source-set totals, and all DerivedOperands R/Z/U/package/comparison/diagnostic/compute/io formulas
require budgetProfileProjection to equal the deterministic closed constants projection and approved external binding to match formula/schema/profile bytes without a self hash
require candidateRecordsMax=C, tiedCandidateIndicesMax=C, and fieldComparisonsMax=9*C+16 for each run after guarded arithmetic

require executionBranch to determine all applicable admit/executed compute, byte-I/O, descriptor-cardinality, and eight-phase memory proof operands; inapplicable values are null and are never fabricated zero
require DStarted <= DAdmit, DCompleted <= DStarted, diagnostic replay operands to equal synchronous interleaved work actually performed, and maxPendingDiagnosticJobs=0

require partialBytesWritten and read-for-verification evidence through comparisonManifestPartialBytesWrittenExecuted and comparisonManifestPartialBytesReadForVerificationExecuted; failurePackageUpper and retained descriptor cardinalities must match the terminal branch
require conditional reference-owned memory upper to use incremental encoders, prohibit whole-object serialization, and equal the maximum of the eight phaseUpperBytes values
require every source-set path to be normalized ASCII segments with no leading or trailing slash and no empty, dot, or dot-dot segment

require partialSuccessRootCustody to mirror current-partial disposition/counters only when currentWriter=COMPARISON_MANIFEST and otherwise use NOT_CREATED; any other preserved ordinary-node partial exists only in failurePathAccounting and retainedArtifacts; deletion is legal only after proving exact zero bytes

HOLD unless every APPROVED_FROZEN object structurally resolves ContractBindingApproved and its deterministic external approved-contract/profile projection; standalone lifecycle fields do not prove approval

require primaryTerminalStatus and axisStates.primary to select the same structurally coupled PC, PN, PO, PR, or PE branch on COMPARISON and SUCCESS_ROOT_INSTALL failure roots; DIAGNOSTIC failure roots require PC only

require every success comparison-manifest branch and every failure-manifest branch to persist the complete DerivedOperands proof; branch-couple executionBranch, raw execution counters, package, I/O, memory, and comparison/diagnostic operands

require the failurePathAccounting executionBranch x failedStage x writerCursor x currentWriter x partialDisposition row to be one legal row of the exhaustive formula table and recompute completed nodes, current partial, retained descriptors, artifactCountUpper, every byte upper, Completed, NextPartialUpper, failurePackageUpper, and every admit/executed I/O value without prose defaults
require comparisonDiagnostic candidateRecords=2*C and reject before allocation unless guarded 2*C <= max_live_candidate_records=5000; candidateRecords never exceeds 5000

require selectionRecords and streamWriteBuffers to equal the exact phase indicator formulas; selectionRecords may be two only in comparisonDiagnostic and streamWriteBuffers may be two only in comparisonDiagnostic
require encoderFrames and containerCount to equal the phase-specific indicator formulas, with no unused RECORD_BASE term and no whole-object serialization
require primaryLedgerBytes <=268435456, comparisonLedgerBytes <=134217728, diagnosticLedgerBytes <=67108864, including direct manifest ledger fields; reject each exact cap plus one

require proposal budget projections to carry only PROPOSAL_UNAPPROVED and no externalBindingId; approved budget projections require APPROVED_FROZEN plus an externalBindingId and are legal only inside a matching ExternalApprovedContractProjection or ContractBindingApproved
require each source-set entries array to have unique entries whose normalized path values are strictly increasing in ASCII byte order, with no duplicate path even when other entry fields differ
require ReferenceSpec candidates to be strictly increasing integers, alphaHex to decode to 0<alpha<1, and tieToleranceHex to decode to a finite value >=0

require RawComputeCounters to include completed and current-unemitted comparison work plus completed and current-partial diagnostic work, remain monotone, obey branch caps, and reproduce every executed ComputeOperands field
require M=max(1 and every known n,h,N,C,T,B,bins), blockCount=q, and WState=W with branch-defined null/known rules before any digit-domain or byte-upper calculation

require CandidateCardinalityOperands primary=L*C, observed=hasObserved*C, comparison=2*Q*C, diagnosticReplay=D*C for admit/executed counters; each persisted-ledger value must be <=maxLedgerCandidateRecords and cap+1 must fail

require sourceIdentityStatus NOT_COMPLETED with null implementationSourceSets before closure and COMPLETE with exactly three embedded source sets for every later failure cursor; source identity is embedded evidence, never a sidecar artifact
require current-unemitted comparison and current-partial diagnostic counters to be zero outside their exact active cursors and to be included in executed work before terminal failure

require DAdmit=0 for null or analytically unevaluable terminal branches and otherwise min(J,RAdmit); increment DStarted before a diagnostic header and DCompleted only after its footer, fail before a J+1 group, and derive ZAdmit/ZExecuted from exact group rows

require FieldComparison to select exactly one comparisonRule branch, recompute residual and matches, use fixed 0x1.0000000000000p-46 only for FLOAT_ABS_TOL, use no tolerance for exact, hexadecimal-exact, or tail rules, and reject cross-domain or bogus scalar values

require each comparison record status to fold all FieldComparison matches and coverage; AGREEMENT has no disagreement codes or diagnostic indices, DISAGREEMENT has required stable codes and completed diagnostic linkage, NOT_COMPARABLE follows an exact adverse branch, and the terminal root folds ordered record statuses

require exact aggregate numerator=1+E and denominator=T; finite validReplicateCount+F=B, denominator=B+1, lowerNumerator=1+E, upperNumerator=1+E+F, exact hexadecimal bounds, and p/decision only when observed is valid and F=0; verify production and reference fields independently

require every writer cursor to carry exact active stream chunk index, current record index, completed rows in the current writer, writer-observed bytes, and source identity state; reject inconsistent cursor progress

require RuntimeLayoutProfile to persist every memory constant actually used, omit RECORD_BASE, bind proposal NOT_EXECUTED versus approved PASSED probe evidence and runtime identity, and require exact incrementalEncoderBytesUpper=encoderFrames*maxCanonicalTokenBytes

require RowMultiplicityOperands complete/failure counts to sum to exact L and comparison record-kind counts to sum to exact R for each admit/executed branch; use resolved row branches plus one LF each
require DiagnosticRowMultiplicityOperands nine kind/family counts to sum to Z for admit/executed values and to reproduce heterogeneous diagnostic bytes exactly
require primaryTerminalClass and executionBranch to select the exact legal diagnostic and failure-table rows; COMPLETE is the only class that permits a diagnostic cursor

require lifecycle-free leaf rows and sidecars to inherit proposal/approved authority only from their unique terminal manifest; no independently valid leaf may assert APPROVED_FROZEN without a ContractBindingApproved

require terminal artifactStatus, ContractBinding kind, BudgetProfileProjection kind, and RuntimeLayoutProfile kind to be the same proposal or approved lifecycle; the schema structurally couples terminal DerivedOperands memory profile

FloatHex.description: Canonical finite IEEE-754 binary64 hexadecimal spelling; semantic verifier must enforce float.fromhex(value).hex() exact round trip.

x-semanticOnlyInvariants: artifact lifecycle and external approval binding equality
NULL_DISABLED zero-scan execution history and RExecuted=1
conditional replay uses only ordered completed production actual.replicates states; no independently generated RNG or pre-execution plan artifact is authorized
T+1, B+2, observed-failure 2, and null-bind 1 record ordering/cardinality
interleaved diagnostic discovery with zero pending-job queue
source-set ordinal/path/hash/byte totals, sourceSetId digest, and transitive dependency closure
canonical finite binary64 FloatHex round trip
all DerivedOperands formulas, digests, byte domains, and custody observations

x-verifierContracts.sourcePathOrder: For each source-set role, decode paths as ASCII bytes and require path[i-1] < path[i] for every i>0 after normalized-segment validation; equality is forbidden independently of uniqueItems.
x-verifierContracts.finiteReplay: Only ordered state identities already present in completed production actual.replicates may be replayed; no preexecution or independently generated schedule exists.
x-verifierContracts.failureAccounting: Select exactly one normative formula-table row by executionBranch, failedStage, writerCursor, currentWriter, and partialDisposition; all completed counts, descriptor counts, byte uppers, partial counters, PackageOperands, IoOperands, and failure retainedArtifacts must recompute from that row.
x-verifierContracts.memory: Recompute selectionRecords, streamWriteBuffers, encoderFrames, and containerCount from the exact phase indicator equations; comparisonDiagnostic additionally requires guarded 2*C<=5000.
x-verifierContracts.lifecycle: BudgetProfileProjection at the schema root is proposal-only. An approved profile is not a standalone root and is valid only as the required child of a matching approved external contract/binding.
x-verifierContracts.scalarRanges: Candidates are strictly increasing; decoded alphaHex is in (0,1); decoded tieToleranceHex is >=0; every FloatHex is finite and exact-round-trip canonical.
